def fit(stress, dt, t, x, y, rate):
    from scipy.optimize import least_squares
    past, hold, memory = stress
    tail = np.r_[np.cumsum(dt[:0:-1])[::-1], 0.0]
    total = dt.sum()
    cm, rm = (np.isfinite(y), np.isfinite(rate))
    obs = np.r_[y[cm], rate[rm]]

    def arrays(logtau):
        tau = np.exp(logtau)
        decay = np.exp(-dt[:, None] / tau)
        later = np.exp(-tail[:, None] / tau)
        long = np.exp(-total / tau)
        k = later * (1 - decay)
        dk = (tail[:, None] * k - dt[:, None] * later * decay) / tau
        delta = hold[:, None] - past @ k - memory * long
        dd = -past @ dk - memory * long * total / tau
        future = np.exp(-t[:, None] / tau)
        rise = 1 - future
        a = np.concatenate((delta[:, None, :] * rise, x[:, None, :] * t[None, :, None]), axis=2)
        da = dd[:, None, :] * rise - delta[:, None, :] * future * t[:, None] / tau
        b = np.column_stack((delta / tau, x))
        db = (dd - delta) / tau
        return (np.vstack((a[cm], b[rm])), np.vstack((da[cm], db[rm])))

    def mv(a, b):
        return np.einsum('ij,j->i', a, b)

    def mad(e, axis=None):
        return 1.4826 * np.nanmedian(np.abs(e - np.nanmedian(e, axis=axis, keepdims=True)), axis=axis)
    w = np.ones(len(obs)) / 0.012

    def fun(p):
        a, _ = arrays(p[:2])
        return (mv(a, p[2:]) - obs) * w

    def jac(p):
        a, da = arrays(p[:2])
        return np.column_stack((da * p[2:4], a)) * w[:, None]

    def opt(p, f):
        return least_squares(fun, p, jac=jac, loss='cauchy', f_scale=f, x_scale='jac', bounds=(np.r_[np.log([0.051, 0.051]), np.full(x.shape[1] + 2, -np.inf)], np.r_[np.log([24.99, 24.99]), np.full(x.shape[1] + 2, np.inf)]), max_nfev=180)
    starts = []
    grid = (0.2, 0.35, 0.55, 0.9, 1.5, 2.5, 4.0, 6.5, 10.0)
    for i, a in enumerate(grid):
        for b in grid[i + 1:]:
            q = np.log([a, b])
            A, _ = arrays(q)
            theta = np.linalg.lstsq(A, obs, rcond=None)[0]
            for _ in range(4):
                err = mv(A, theta) - obs
                u = 1 / np.sqrt(1 + (err / max(0.012, 3 * np.median(abs(err)))) ** 2)
                theta = np.linalg.lstsq(A * u[:, None], obs * u, rcond=None)[0]
            e = mv(A, theta) - obs
            starts.append((np.mean(np.log1p((e / 0.025) ** 2)), np.r_[q, theta]))
    candidates = [opt(p, 2.0) for _, p in sorted(starts, key=lambda p: p[0])[:3]]
    p = min((v for v in candidates if v.x[0] < v.x[1]), key=lambda v: v.cost).x
    for _ in range(2):
        A, _ = arrays(p[:2])
        err = mv(A, p[2:]) - obs
        ec = np.full(cm.shape, np.nan)
        ec[cm] = err[:cm.sum()]
        sig = np.maximum(0.002, mad(ec, 0))
        rs = max(0.002, mad(err[cm.sum():])) if rm.any() else 0.01
        w = np.r_[np.broadcast_to(1 / sig, cm.shape)[cm], np.full(rm.sum(), 1 / rs)]
        p = opt(p, 1.5).x
    return (np.exp(p[:2]), p[2:])

def refine(m, d):
    from scipy.optimize import least_squares
    tr, te = (d['train'], d['test'])
    x, miss = m._features(tr, te)
    n = len(tr['lab_id'])
    x = x[:n]
    lab = tr['lab_id']
    checks = d['calibration_load_cells']
    cl, cx, cy = map(np.asarray, (checks['lab_id'], checks['cmd_stress'], checks['true_stress']))
    cal = m._calibration(checks)
    usable = np.isfinite(cx) & np.isfinite(cy)
    sparse = []
    for j in range(4):
        k = usable & (cl == j) & (np.abs(cy - (cal[j, 0] * cx + cal[j, 1])) < 0.0015)
        if (k.sum() < 3 or np.ptp(cx[k]) < 0.25) and np.sum((lab == j) & ~miss[:n]) >= 8:
            sparse.append((j, k))
    if not sparse:
        return cal
    dt, t = (d['past_dt'], d['eval_times'])
    y = tr['strain_curves_obs'] - tr['strain_0'][:, None]
    rate = tr['instant_rate_obs']
    good = ~miss[:n] & ~np.isin(lab, [j for j, _ in sparse])
    if good.sum() < 20:
        return cal
    s = m._stresses(tr, cal)
    tau, coef = m._fit(tuple((a[good] for a in s)), dt, t, x[good], y[good], rate[good])
    for j, check in sparse:
        k = (lab == j) & ~miss[:n]
        past, hold, mem = (a[k] for a in s)
        a, r = m._design(tau, (past, hold, mem), dt, t, x[k], d['yield_stress'], False)
        yc, yr = (y[k], rate[k])
        cm, rm = (np.isfinite(yc), np.isfinite(yr))
        err = np.r_[(a @ coef - yc)[cm], (r @ coef - yr)[rm]]
        for ml, mh in [(tr['past_stress_cmd'][k], tr['stress_hold_cmd'][k]), (np.ones_like(past), np.ones_like(hold))]:
            da, dr = m._design(tau, (ml, mh, np.zeros_like(mem)), dt, t, np.zeros_like(x[k]), d['yield_stress'], False)
            deriv = np.r_[(da @ coef)[cm], (dr @ coef)[rm]]
            if 'cols' not in locals():
                cols = []
            cols.append(deriv)
        J = np.column_stack(cols)
        del cols
        check_err = cx[check] * cal[j, 0] + cal[j, 1] - cy[check]
        Jc = np.column_stack((cx[check], np.ones(check.sum())))

        def f(q):
            return np.r_[(err + J @ q) / 0.02, (check_err + Jc @ q) / 0.00045, q / 0.35]
        q = least_squares(f, np.zeros(2), loss='soft_l1', f_scale=1.0, bounds=(-0.35, 0.35)).x
        cal[j] += q
    return cal

def _features(train, test):
    lab = np.r_[train['lab_id'], test['lab_id']]
    stratum = np.r_[train['stratum'], test['stratum']]
    raw = np.vstack((train['coupon_features_raw'], test['coupon_features_raw']))
    ref = np.vstack((train['ref_coupons'], test['ref_coupons']))
    x = np.empty_like(raw, dtype=float)
    for j in np.unique(lab):
        m = lab == j
        r = ref[m]
        r = r[:, np.sum(np.isfinite(r), axis=0) >= 2]
        shift = np.median(np.nanmean(r, axis=0)) if r.size else 0.0
        scale = np.median(np.nanstd(r, axis=0)) if r.size else 1.0
        x[m] = (raw[m] - shift) / (scale if scale > 0 else 1.0)
    missing = ~np.isfinite(x)
    cells = np.unique(np.column_stack((lab, stratum)), axis=0)
    w = np.zeros(len(lab))
    for j, s in cells:
        m = (lab == j) & (stratum == s)
        w[m] = 1 / m.sum()
    denominator = (~missing).T @ w
    means = np.divide(np.where(missing, 0.0, x).T @ w, denominator, out=np.zeros(x.shape[1]), where=denominator > 0)
    return (np.column_stack((np.ones(len(x)), np.where(missing, means, x))), missing)

def _design(tau, past, hold, dt, t, x):
    trailing = np.r_[np.cumsum(dt[:0:-1])[::-1], 0.0]
    kernel = np.exp(-trailing[:, None] / tau) * -np.expm1(-dt[:, None] / tau)
    delta = hold[:, None] - past @ kernel
    relax = -np.expm1(-t[:, None] / tau)
    a = np.concatenate((delta[:, None, :] * relax, x[:, None, :] * t[None, :, None]), axis=2)
    r = np.column_stack((delta / tau, x))
    return (a, r)

def _fit(past, hold, dt, t, x, y, rate):
    from scipy.optimize import least_squares
    cm, rm = (np.isfinite(y), np.isfinite(rate))
    yc, yr = (y[cm], rate[rm])
    initial = []
    grid = (0.24, 0.42, 0.72, 1.2, 2.15, 3.75, 6.0, 8.0)
    for i, u in enumerate(grid[:-1]):
        for v in grid[i + 1:]:
            tau = np.array([u, v])
            a, r = _design(tau, past, hold, dt, t, x)
            a, r = (a[cm], r[rm])
            mat = np.vstack((a, r))
            obs = np.r_[yc, yr]
            theta = np.linalg.lstsq(mat, obs, rcond=None)[0]
            e = obs - np.einsum('ij,j->i', mat, theta)
            w = np.sqrt(np.minimum(1.0, max(0.006, 2.5 * np.median(abs(e))) / np.maximum(abs(e), 1e-12)))
            theta = np.linalg.lstsq(mat * w[:, None], obs * w, rcond=None)[0]
            e = obs - np.einsum('ij,j->i', mat, theta)
            initial.append((np.mean(np.log1p((e / 0.035) ** 2)), np.r_[np.log(tau), theta]))
    initial.sort(key=lambda pair: pair[0])
    scales = (0.04, 0.04)
    bounds = (np.r_[np.log([0.2, 0.2]), np.full(7, -np.inf)], np.r_[np.log([8.0, 8.0]), np.full(7, np.inf)])

    def residual(p):
        a, r = _design(np.exp(p[:2]), past, hold, dt, t, x)
        ce = np.einsum('ij,j->i', a[cm], p[2:]) - yc
        re = np.einsum('ij,j->i', r[rm], p[2:]) - yr
        return np.r_[ce / scales[0], re / scales[1]]
    fit = min((least_squares(residual, p, bounds=bounds, loss='cauchy', x_scale='jac', max_nfev=140) for _, p in initial[:3]), key=lambda result: result.cost)
    e = residual(fit.x)
    ec, er = (e[:len(yc)] * scales[0], e[len(yc):] * scales[1])

    def robust_sigma(v):
        return 1.4826 * np.median(abs(v - np.median(v))) if v.size else 0.01
    scales = (max(0.001, 2.5 * robust_sigma(ec)), max(0.001, 2.5 * robust_sigma(er)))
    fit = least_squares(residual, fit.x, bounds=bounds, loss='cauchy', x_scale='jac', max_nfev=140)
    tau, theta = (np.exp(fit.x[:2]), fit.x[2:].copy())
    if tau[0] > tau[1]:
        tau = tau[::-1].copy()
        theta[:2] = theta[:2][::-1]
    return (tau, theta)

def _refine_sparse_calibration(checks, gain, bias, identified, lab, cmd_past, cmd_hold, dt, t, x, y, rate, complete):
    from scipy.optimize import least_squares
    source = complete & identified[lab]
    if source.sum() < 12:
        return
    known = lab[source]
    tau, theta = _fit(cmd_past[source] * gain[known, None] + bias[known, None], cmd_hold[source] * gain[known] + bias[known], dt, t, x[source], y[source], rate[source])
    check_lab, check_cmd, check_true = (np.asarray(checks[k]) for k in ('lab_id', 'cmd_stress', 'true_stress'))
    for j in np.flatnonzero(~identified):
        use = complete & (lab == j)
        if use.sum() < 4:
            continue
        m = (check_lab == j) & np.isfinite(check_cmd) & np.isfinite(check_true)
        anchor_cmd = np.median(check_cmd[m]) if m.any() else 0.0
        anchor_true = np.median(check_true[m]) if m.any() else 0.0
        past, hold = (cmd_past[use] - anchor_cmd, cmd_hold[use] - anchor_cmd)
        a, r = _design(tau, past, hold, dt, t, x[use])
        q, v = _design(tau, np.ones_like(past), np.ones_like(hold), dt, t, x[use])
        curve_base = (x[use] @ theta[2:])[:, None] * t + anchor_true * (q[:, :, :2] @ theta[:2])
        rate_base = x[use] @ theta[2:] + anchor_true * (v[:, :2] @ theta[:2])
        curve_target, rate_target = (y[use] - curve_base, rate[use] - rate_base)
        cm, rm = (np.isfinite(curve_target), np.isfinite(rate_target))
        target = np.r_[curve_target[cm], rate_target[rm]]
        design = np.r_[(a[:, :, :2] @ theta[:2])[cm], (r[:, :2] @ theta[:2])[rm]][:, None]
        if not m.any():
            design = np.column_stack((design, np.r_[(q[:, :, :2] @ theta[:2])[cm], (v[:, :2] @ theta[:2])[rm]]))
        if np.linalg.matrix_rank(design) < design.shape[1]:
            continue
        start = np.array([gain[j]]) if m.any() else np.array([gain[j], bias[j]])
        fit = least_squares(lambda p: design @ p - target, start, loss='cauchy', f_scale=0.02)
        if fit.success and fit.x[0] > 0:
            gain[j] = fit.x[0]
            bias[j] = anchor_true - gain[j] * anchor_cmd if m.any() else fit.x[1]

    keep = complete if complete.sum() >= 12 else np.ones(n, dtype=bool)
    y = np.asarray(train['strain_curves_obs']) - np.asarray(train['strain_0'])[:, None]
    rate_obs = np.asarray(train['instant_rate_obs'])
    if not identified.all():
        _refine_sparse_calibration(checks, gain, bias, identified, np.asarray(train['lab_id']), np.asarray(train['past_stress_cmd']), np.asarray(train['stress_hold_cmd']), dt, t, x[:n], y, rate_obs, complete)
    past, hold = stresses(train)
    tau, theta = _fit(past[keep], hold[keep], dt, t, x[:n][keep], y[keep], rate_obs[keep])
    past, hold = stresses(test)
    a, r = _design(tau, past, hold, dt, t, x[n:])
    curve = np.asarray(test['strain_0'])[:, None] + np.einsum('ntp,p->nt', a, theta)
    rate = r @ theta
    obs_rate = np.asarray(test['instant_rate_obs'])
    update = missing[n:].any(axis=1) & np.isfinite(obs_rate)
    curve[update] += (obs_rate[update] - rate[update])[:, None] * t
    rate[update] = obs_rate[update]
    return {'estimated_taus': tau, 'hereditary_weights': theta, 'viscoplastic_weights': np.zeros(2), 'predicted_strain': curve, 'initial_rate_pred': rate}
